dex.entry: The line's final form — a sleek armoured tidal-beast that rides currents at high speed, its shell now a hydrodynamic shield. Commands entire tidal zones. From beach-trinket collector to tidal apex — the full transformation arc hits hard at its reveal.

art.silhouette: Streamlined low-slung body, swept-back shell ridges like breaking waves, twin luminous teal eye-stalks, long trailing fin-limbs. Seafoam-blue and deep indigo palette, white crest markings.
